description: WP-C7 Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) SWIFT RUIN (Venatari with Verutum Lances, once per phase per army): Rapid Ingress on that unit is -1 CP and ignores other uses that phase. Fixture cus11e_c7_fight_end, entered at P1 Orks' Movement phase (battle round 2). Setup privileges: auto wound allocation; the Custodes (P2) have 0 CP; the Venatari with Verutum Lances are placed in strategic reserves. With 0 CP the generic RAPID INGRESS check fails but the target-aware one passes (Swift Ruin). A real click on End Movement Phase opens P2's Rapid Ingress dialog, whose Venatari row reads 'Arrive (0 CP — Swift Ruin)'; a real click uses it: P2 still has 0 CP, the unit is the Rapid Ingress unit, the game log names Swift Ruin and its once-per-phase army use is recorded. (The arrival placement itself is the core Rapid Ingress flow, not under test.)

steps.script:
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
var u = GameState.state.units["U_VENATARI_VL_A"]
u["status"] = 7
u["reserve_type"] = "strategic_reserves"
for m in u.models:
	m["position"] = null
return true
steps.comment: setup privilege: auto wound allocation; player(s) 2 CP 0 (no paid stratagem competes with the abilities under test) (see description)
redraw the board after the setup privilege
decline P1's windows here (not under test)
0 CP: RAPID INGRESS is not affordable in general
Swift Ruin: -1 CP on the Venatari with Verutum Lances = 0 CP

steps.script:
var d = tree.current_scene._phase_end_confirm
if d != null and d.visible:
	d.get_ok_button().pressed.emit()
return true

steps.comment: decline P1's windows here (not under test)
P2's Rapid Ingress dialog is on screen although P2 has 0 CP
real click (P2): Arrive on the Venatari for 0 CP
the Venatari arrive by Rapid Ingress
Swift Ruin: once per phase, per army — recorded
